facts.fact: Clara 强忍着没告诉 Quint：记忆里的金眼睛小女孩「头发像我的脏金色，但眼睛像你，完美无缺」——她相信那是 Quint 的孩子。
facts.anchor: Her hair is more dirty blonde, like mine, but she has your eyes, and she’s perfect in every way.

facts.fact: 早餐争吵：Clara 怒斥被当「太脆弱太女性化」对待；Quint 反问「我们永远无法知道了」——戳中他十年不婚的痛。
facts.anchor: “Had I stayed, would you have treated me like this my whole life? Too fragile, too feminine for anything difficult or unsavory?”

facts.fact: Kitty 来访问有无男友：Quint 抢答「她已订婚」——用「无威胁」声明自保；Clara 立刻唱反调「未必会嫁」。
facts.anchor: “She’s engaged.” His expression to Kitty is reassuring. I’m no threat.

facts.fact: Clara 对 Pratt 姐妹摊牌式闲谈：未婚夫不相信我放下了旧情人——「我确信我根本没放下」。
facts.anchor: “An old boyfriend my fiancé doesn’t believe I’ve gotten over.”

facts.fact: Clara 从书架抽《劝导》读出著名引文（「I have loved none but you… never inconstant」）——Austen 的迟来告白与她的处境互文。
Ben 蹲守几夜终于拍到人来：Lord Bailemore——英国外交官，娶了美国人，比国王还富有。
facts.anchor: A man showed up this afternoon.

facts.fact: 视频核心：Gibbons 向 Bailemore 出售「伦敦灭绝生物剂」（数周灭伦敦、数月灭全英）。
facts.anchor: The key to power I promised you is a biological agent so powerful I can wipe out the population of London in a matter of weeks—and all of England within months.”

facts.fact: 试毒演示：同伙强行灌乞妇毒剂当场抽搐死亡——Gibbons 以人命演示武器。
facts.anchor: With careless movements, he forces the woman’s head back, ignoring her screams

facts.fact: 勒索结构：解药药丸每粒两万美元——投毒与解药双向牟利；同伙当场试药存活作证。
facts.anchor: “Twenty thousand dollars per pill,” Gibbons announces.

facts.fact: Ben 的计划：把 Gibbons 引到 Allen 宅、在行动前把他送回未来。
facts.anchor: “I intend to lure him here, of course, and send him back to the future before he does a thing

facts.fact: 章末反转：Ben 亮出缴获的整包解药药丸——勒索链条的钥匙在他手里。
facts.anchor: Because I have these.” Ben pulls a package from his jacket and reveals a thick plastic package full of tiny white pills.
